tools.name: open_subthread

You do not wait for it: keep working; when it needs the user, goes to review, ends or fails you receive "[Subthread #n · title · status] ...". A subthread cannot open subthreads of its own, and a thread has at most 5 unfinished subthreads. To build on your own changes, give repos [{repo, base: <your thread branch>}] (push your work first): its PR then targets your branch. Your thread cannot finish while a subthread is unfinished (close_subthread ends one).

tools.name: publish_file
tools.description: Publish a file you made (HTML prototype, Markdown doc, PDF, text, JSON, CSV) as a project deliverable. The platform uploads it from your working directory and hosts it; people view it on the Deliverables page and their comments come back to you as messages. A directory with index.html is published as a small site (it may contain images and other assets). Pass deliverable_id to publish a new version of an earlier deliverable. Screenshots and images are not deliverables: a lone PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP is saved as an attachment in your thread's messages instead (no deliverable, cannot be a new version), and a lone SVG is refused. To put an image in a report, publish it in one directory with the report's index.html, or inline it in the HTML (an SVG can be written straight into the HTML); Markdown cannot show images. Cite an attachment (its id or URL) only in your written report.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Schedule a wake-up: at the time you set, the platform sends you (or, for the coordinator, a thread's lead) the message, even if your session is idle or parked. Use it instead of sleeping or polling when you must wait for something outside (CI, a deploy, a time the user named), and for recurring work the user asks for ("every morning at 9 report…"). tools.description: Set your speech-bubble text in the office (one short sentence on what you are doing). Call it when you switch work; it does not change your state or position and expires after 10 minutes.
